candidates.quote: The Town has paid the Owner a construction grant of $2,100,000 from the Port Wren Housing Fund.
The Owner shall keep 22 of the 140 apartments in the building as restricted apartments, in the mix shown in Schedule 1.
A restricted apartment shall be leased only to a household with income not greater than sixty percent (60%) of area median income.
candidates.wording: income not greater than sixty percent (60%) of area median income

candidates.quote: The Owner shall check each household's income before the lease is signed and keep the papers for five years.
candidates.wording: keep the papers for five years

candidates.quote: Rent for a restricted apartment shall not exceed the maximum rent published each year by the Osprey County Housing Office for the sixty percent income level.
candidates.wording: shall not exceed the maximum rent published each year
candidates.value: Osprey County Housing Office limit for 60% level

candidates.quote: This Covenant shall remain in effect until June 30, 2049.
This Covenant runs with the land and binds the Owner and every later owner of the building.
candidates.wording: runs with the land and binds the Owner and every later owner

candidates.quote: The Owner shall submit a certified rent roll to the Town each year no later than February 15.
candidates.wording: shall submit a certified rent roll

candidates.quote: The Town shall send the Owner written notice of a default.
candidates.wording: shall send the Owner written notice

candidates.quote: If the Owner fails to cure a default within 90 days after written notice, the Owner shall repay the Town the full amount of the construction grant.
candidates.wording: repay the Town the full amount of the construction grant
candidates.value: 90 days to cure, then full grant repayment
